whatItIs: PQClean is an open-source project in the post-quantum cryptography category. It is maintained by PQClean and primarily looks like a C/C++ codebase. > [!WARNING] > **Deprecation Notice:** PQClean is no longer under active maintenance and we plan to archive it as read-only in July 2026.

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches post-quantum cryptography workflows in practice.
